companyDescription.title: Company Description
companyDescription.text: Company Introduction – T-Systems ICT India Pvt. Ltd. T-Systems Information and Communication Technology India Private Limited (T-Systems ICT India Pvt. Ltd.) is a certified Great Place To Work®, proudly recognized for its strong people-first culture and commitment to employee excellence. As a wholly owned subsidiary of T-Systems International GmbH, T-Systems India operates out of Pune and Bangalore, with a dynamic team of over 4,200 professionals delivering high-value IT services to group customers worldwide. T-Systems India plays a key role in this global vision by delivering integrated, end-to-end IT solutions and sector-specific software to drive transformation across industries, including automotive, manufacturing, logistics, transportation, healthcare, and the public sector. For over 25 years, T-Systems International GmbH has been at the forefront of digital innovation, driving progress and fostering digital optimism. As a leading European IT services provider and a proud part of Deutsche Telekom, T-Systems delivers transformative digitalization projects backed by deep expertise in consulting, cloud, AI, cybersecurity, and connectivity. With a global workforce of 26,000 employees across 26 countries, we set industry benchmarks in efficiency, sovereignty, security, and reliability—empowering organizations to unlock their full digital potential. With annual revenues exceeding EUR 4.0 billion (2024), T-Systems stands as one of Europe’s foremost digital transformation partners, committed to shaping the future of enterprise technology.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
Role - Full Stack Software Developer with strong DevOps Focus

Experience Required : 7+ Years

Location : Pune

Join us in building cloud-native applications and scalable platforms that make a real impact. As a Full Stack Software Developer with a strong DevOps mindset, you will work across the entire software lifecycle, from designing and developing modern applications to automating deployments, operating cloud environments, and driving observability excellence on Microsoft Azure.

Your Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain applications using .NET (C#), DevOps (Docker & Kubernetes) and Angular (GTH)
  • Build and implement cloud-native solutions on Microsoft Azure
  • Develop and optimize CI/CD pipelines and GitOps workflows
  • Deploy and operate containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes
  • Automate build, test, and deployment processes
  • Contribute to modern software and cloud architectures
  • Ensure application performance, reliability, and scalability
  • Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, architects, and development teams

Your Profile

  • 6-9+ years of hands-on experience in full-stack software development using .NET (C#), modern web technologies, and DevOps practices
  • Hands-on experience with Angular and TypeScript (Nice to Have)
  • Strong understanding of Microsoft Azure and cloud-native architectures
  • Practical experience with Docker and Kubernetes (Must Have)
  • Experience managing Kubernetes deployments using Helm and Argo CD
  • Knowledge of CI/CD, GitOps, and Infrastructure as Code principles
  • Experience implementing and optimizing monitoring, logging, and telemetry solutions
  • Knowledge of OpenTelemetry, Grafana Tempo, Prometheus, and Grafana
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a hands-on mentality
  • Team player with a passion for modern DevOps practices and continuous improvement

Technologies: .NET, C#, Angular, TypeScript, Microsoft Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Argo CD, OpenTelemetry, Grafana Tempo, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki,  GitHub Actions, Terraform.
